title: wiki render rejects index.md; only project/wiki/ prefix works
description:
Reproduced on kbs 0.19.1 / Kanbus develop.

`kbs wiki render index.md` and `kbs wiki render index` return \"wiki page not found\" even when the file is at project/wiki/index.md. `kbs wiki render project/wiki/index.md` and an absolute path work.

Product rule: accept `index`, `index.md`, and paths relative to project/wiki/. Keep the prefixed form. Document whichever you keep as canonical.

Researcher hit this writing project/wiki/index.md and project/wiki/concepts/something-intelligence.md (subdirs render fine once the path is prefixed).
